name: Percsyn
author: Serhii Tonkoshkuryk
description: A PO-32 / Microtonic style drum synth, in two plugins. percsyn is a synth engine (one sound across the keyboard, 10 built-in sounds and 16 places for PO-32 transfers recorded into the slot's sample).
credits: PO-32 patch model after libpo32 by Eric Lewis (MIT); in op1r by pcppcp
